book.name: Luk
book.title: Yesu Kalisi-te banye nivasa lohvu Luk kaavu

content: Malia hako Yesu
Hôôk busin-anju hil Lom-ate yêêv bop Sisa Ogastas nêêl nambe sil kaavu omaahonôôn pin haalend.
Kul-anjo lako lak nyendoos hôôk busin sen Sailinias tu yêêv bop-ambe nanggin Siliaa-to,
om hil pin lalaah sil ambaand dangga dosin ti ti in nambe kaavu sil haalend.
Tombe Yusep kandi vu bayêên Nasaalet vu Galili be la valup Yudia-te bayêên bop sen Devit ambaan bôôy-ato, danêêl nambe Betlehem, in Yusep-ate danggakook neep vu Devit.
+ o 2:5 Luk 1:27*Om yuuh vane Malia lala in kaavu yuuh haalend, tonde Malia noow hôôk.
Yuuh lala dandôô-ju be ngaaho lak in Malia gako noow,
tombe Malia hako nowaatuk-ambe vayum hôôk tôômb-ambe hambe neep hôôk bik-asote kaambum, in omaahonôôn lahilin bayêên vaatêêvak-ate de taaku vuun ti me-neep e.
Angela lanêêl Yesu banye vu bik sipsip heendin-aso
Vu taakuu-ju vaheey mondanggin bik sipsip vu paahup alo hôôk busin,
tonde Omaaho Bop-ate angela la hato vu sil, de Omaaho Bop-ate nikaapulis têêlang-ambe lohvu sil pin, tombe sil layêênin lôôt,
lemu angela nêêl vu sil nambe, “Ham-ame anjêênin e. Ham gango, sa laam in naanêêl banye nivasa ti naas vu ham, tombe hil pin davu daapêêlis lôôt.
In gêên-anjo vêêh ti hako noow neep Devit-ate taaku Betlehem, ond hamate omaaho sen ham natung mem in nambe dôôvu ham-ato, in yi omaaho sen Anutu yoo holin yi vulôôt-ato osin yi Omaaho Bop.
Om ham ana gato be ham anjak ni naambe vakasin-anjo keen, in ham e angge naambe sil layum unoopasiv ti hôôk tôômb-ambe lambe neep hôôk bik-asote kaambum.”
Angela nêêl nambêênju, tonde pavis atombe hil baandoni ngeeyaata lôôt lato daale having angela tii-jôôto, be lavand hôôk Anutu nambe,
+ o 2:14 Luk 19:38*“Yiiy gako Anutu haale jak vu baandoni, tonde vakasin melaas nanjip vu hil sen Anutu nayi sil anivasaa-to.”
Bik sipsip heendin-aso lala dayi Yesu
Angela lavuuh sil-ande lalaah baandoni lung la, le mem bik sipsip-ate heendin-aso lanêêl nambe, “Ham-o, yana Betlehem-ambe yaangge va sen gêên Omaaho Bop nêêl banye vu yiiy-anjôôto le.”
Om sil kandi pavis-ambe lala lalup atombe latovu Malia yuuh Yusep dando, tonde unoopasiv neep hôôk bik-asote kaambum.
+ o 2:17 Luk 2:10-12*Layi lung la tonde latulin vakasin sen lango lak unoopasiv-ato vu yuuh.
Tombe hil pin sen lango vakasin-anjuuto, ond lavindis lôôt in vakasin sen bik sipsip-ate heendin-aso lanêêl-ato,
+ o 2:19 Luk 2:51*lemu Malia samu vakasin pin-anjo hôôk lopayo be ka yoo monavu nando.
Lung atonde sipsip-ate heendin-aso lalaah, tombe lako Omaaho Bop haale lak, de lavand hôôk Anutu in va pin sen lango osin layi ond nôôn ak lohvu angela nêêl vu sil-ato.
Lateey Yesu haale

+ o 2:21 Luk 1:31,59*Busin namaavaalu be vindak yaal lung la le mem lalaah unoopasiv aninaavi, de lateey haale Yesu sen bôôy me-naale hôôk tangganaan alopayo le de naahen, tonde angela nêêl nambe Yesuu-to.
Simeon ayuuh Ana layi Yesu vu Anutu-te dumb bop alo
+ o 2:22 Lev 12:1-8*Busin sen Malia yuuh Yusep samu yuuh anind naavi nohvu Mose-te tanasin-ato lung la, om yuuh lako Yesu be lala Yelusalem in lambu dukana Omaaho Bop nama.

+ o 2:23 Eks 13:2,12,15*Lawiing lohvu Omaaho Bop-ate tanasin sen sil kaavu bôôy-ambe neep-ato nambe, “Unoopasiv tuk pin sen taandin dako sil namunggin-ato ond ham angge sil naambe Omaaho Bop-ate va vaambuung.”

+ o 2:24 Lev 12:8*Om yik Malia yuuh Yusep lala in nambe gatung salivangin gaving, nohvu Omaaho Bop-ate tanasin nêêl nambe, “Ham gatung manak tumbaliiy yuuh, me manak bavi noow yuuh naatu salivangin vu Anutu.”

+ o 2:25 Ais 40:1; Ais 49:13*Tonde sim omaaho ti nando Yelusalem, haale nambe Simeon, ond omaaho nivalok de omaaho sen yoo nalohak vu Anutu, ond monanggin busin sen Anutu nôôh nimeen vêêl in Islel-ato, ond Vavi Vaambuung hôôvu yi,
tonde Vavi Vaambuung yoo nêêl vu bôôy nambe me-le jimb pavis e, yoo ji me lak Omaaho Bop-ate omaaho sen yoo holin yi vulôôt in nambe dôôvu yiiy-ato le mem.
Om Vavi Vaambuung giiy yi be la Anutu-te dumb bop alo, tonde sim Yusep ayuuh Malia lako unoopasiv Yesu be lala lalup-ambe lahuli-lala dumb alo, in lambiing va vu yi nohvu tanasin neep-ato,
tomem Simeon kava Yesu lak-ande pêêlis la vu Anutu nambe,

content.text: “O Omaaho Bop, gêên onaateey gate hil kul vaha malis sa be sa naas osin sa longgpayo melaas nohvu goo ganêêl bôôy-ato.
+ o 2:30 Ais 52:10; Luk 3:6; Tit 2:11*In saahe mengg ak va sen gawiing in nambe dôôvu hey-ato lung la.
Goo samu vaa-ja neep langaah hôôk omaahonôôn pin amend.
+ o 2:32 Ais 42:6; 49:6*Tombe yii-ju tu kin tumin in nambe le bu melangaah vu hil vaalu sen sil-ame Yudaa-to, osin biing-ambe gate hil Islel haalend naatu bopaata.”

content: Simeon nêêl nambêênju lak Yesu, tomem Yesu mangganaan ayuuh tangganaan lavindis lôôt.

+ o 2:34 Ais 8:14; Mat 21:42-44; 1Ko 1:23; 1Pi 2:8*Tonde Simeon lohak yaal-ande nêêl vu Yesu tangganaan Malia nambe, “Angge, unoopasiv-anjo ond Anutu holin in nambe biing-ambe Islel ngeeyaata landupake, de biing-ambe hil ngeeyaata kandi jak. Tonde le taato Anutu-te va vu hil, le hil ngeeyaata le daanêêl vakasin anipaya jak yi,
in nambe omaahôô-ja biing-ambe hil ngeeyaata-te vakasin sen kand navu hôôk londpayôô-to naatok naam langaah, tonde galompayo le nimeen gaving.”

Lung atonde vêêh ti nando, haale nambe Ana, ond hil sen danêêl Anutu-te vakasin langaah-ato ti yi, de mangganaan haale nambe Panuel, de yuuhate danggakook neep vu Asel. Anaa-ju tata lak lôôt, in bôôy ond lak moow-ambe nando having laya lohvu ta namaavaalu be vindak yuuh,

+ o 2:37 1Ti 5:5*tombe laya yimb-ande yoo tu vehaahôôv-ambe nando be tata lak. Tombe yite ta ngeeyaata lôôt lohvu 84, lemu me-havuuh Anutu-te dumb bop e, de nimbaya in vanôôn in nambe nohak vu Anutu, om yoo nalohak vu Anutu hôôk busin-ande langaah nalak busin pin.

+ o 2:38 Ais 52:9*Ond hôôk busin sen Yusep ayuuh Malia lako Yesu la dumb bop alôô-to, ond Ana valup pavis-ambe pêêlis la vu Anutu, de tatekin unoopasiv-anju yite vakasin vu hil pin sen mondanggin in nambe Anutu nôôh nimeen vêêl in Yelusalem-ato.
Yusep hako Yesu yuuh tangganaan-ambe yaal lalaah Nasaalet
+ o 2:39 Mat 2:23*Malia yuuh Yusep samu va pin lohvu Omaaho Bop-ate tanasin nêêl-ato lung la, le mem yaal lalaah lalup Galili-te taaku, be yaal lala dando yaal ambaand Nasaalet.
+ o 2:40 Luk 1:80; 2:52*Tonde unoopasiv linj-ambe bop ak atombe yoo lak va pin ani nivasa lôôt, tombe nando hôôk Anutu-te samu samu lopayo.
Unoopasiv Yesu la Anutu-te dumb bop alo
+ o 2:41 Eks 12:24-27; 23:14-17; Diu 16:1-8*Lohvu ta pin Yesu mangganaan ayuuh tangganaan dala Yelusalem, in dayi busin bop busin haluusin sen Anutu haluuh hil Islel hôôk vu Ijip bôôy-ato.
Tonde Yesu-te ta nomaayuuh-ambe laam yuuh lung la, om yaal lala lalup Yelusalem in lanji busin bop-anju, yik nambe sen yoo dala lak ta pin-ato.
+ o 2:43 Eks 12:18*Layi busin bop-anju lung la de sil lalaah, lemu Yesu yoo naahen nando Yelusalem, le mangganaan ayuuh tangganaan doosin yi,
in yuuh akand vu nambe la having silate hil vaalu. Om hôôk busin tii-ju yuuh mosalo yi tatuuvu mopaatôôv vu yuuhate hil osin nipaapu-so,
le ma de yuuh-ame latovu le, om yuuh oo mosalo be lalaah lalup Yelusalem.
Tombe yuuh oo mosalo yi lôôt lohvu busin yaal, le mem yuuh latovu yi lukando tanasin dangga-so lavuun vu Anutu-te dumb bop alo. Yoo monangoyin silate vakasin-ambe nalingin danggakook vu sil having,
tombe hil pin sen dango yite vakasin-anjuuto ond lavindis lôôt in ka osin vakasin sen nanêêl laah vu sil-ato.

Malia yuuh Yusep latokak yi tombe yuuh lavindis lôôt, tombe tangganaan nêêl vu nambe, “Tuk-e, nambe vaati sen gawiing nambêênjo vu haay mom-anjo? Haay alonggpayo nimeen-ande haay oo mosalo hong lôôt.”
+ o 2:49 Jon 2:16*Le nêêl laah vu yuuh nambe, “Nambe vaati sen muuh navu salo saa-jo? Mak mame alak ni nambe soo le mando hôôk Mangg-ate bayêên-anjo le?”
Lemu yuuh doosin vakasin sen nêêl vu yuuh-anjuuto danggakook,

+ o 2:51 Luk 2:19*tombe la having yuuh-ambe yaal lalaah lato Nasaalet. Tonde yik lak busin pin ond yoo nanye vuun in yuuh lavand, tombe tangganaan samu va pin-anjo neep hôôk lopayo be ka monavu nando.
+ o 2:52 1Sml 2:26; Pro 3:4; Luk 1:80*Yesu bop ak atombe tu omaaho lukook bop, tombe Anutu osin omaahonôôn layi yi nivasa.
